title: Cut checkout steps and fields
benefit: More shoppers finish paying instead of leaving at checkout.
goal: Find the checkout code (Shopify checkout/cart templates, Stripe Checkout session creation, or a custom checkout form). Count steps and form fields, and look for forced account creation, a hidden guest option, and shipping cost shown only at the last step. Propose one bounded change: make guest checkout the default, drop non-essential fields, and show shipping and tax estimates in the cart.
steps: Guest checkout is the default
Checkout asks only for fields the order needs
Shipping and tax estimates show in the cart

title: Speed up the largest product image
benefit: Product pages load faster, so more visitors stay and buy.
goal: Find the product and collection page templates and the hero image tags. Check for missing width/height, no lazy loading below the fold, an eager first image without fetchpriority, and oversized uncompressed files. Propose responsive srcset, modern formats, fetchpriority=high on the first image, and lazy loading everywhere else.
steps: The first product image loads with high priority
Images below the fold load lazily
Images have a set size and come in modern, right-sized files

title: Add product structured data
benefit: Products show price and stock in search results, bringing more qualified visits.
goal: Search product page templates for JSON-LD or microdata. If Product schema (name, image, price, currency, availability, reviews) is missing or hardcoded, add it generated from the same data that renders the page, and make sure price and availability match what is displayed. Do not add fields the store has no data for.
steps: Product pages carry Product data for search engines
That data comes from the same source as the page
Price and stock in it match what the page shows

title: Recover failed payments automatically
benefit: Customers with an expired or declined card stay subscribed instead of silently churning.
goal: Find the billing webhook handler (Stripe invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated). Check that failures are handled: the user is emailed with a link to update their card, access is kept for a grace period, and status is updated when payment later succeeds. Propose the missing handler branches and a billing-portal link in the failure email.
steps: A failed payment emails the customer a link to update their card
Access stays on for a grace period
The account recovers by itself when the payment later succeeds

title: Track the first-value moment
benefit: You can see where new signups get stuck before they ever pay.
goal: Find the signup, onboarding and first-use code paths. List which of signup_completed, first_key_action and upgrade_clicked events are missing from the analytics layer (or add a minimal one if none exists). Propose the smallest set of named events with user id and timestamp, wired at those code points, without changing UI.
steps: Finishing signup is recorded
The first key action is recorded
Clicking upgrade is recorded

title: Add a one-step cancel save offer
benefit: Some cancelling customers pause or downgrade instead of leaving.
goal: Find the cancel flow in the settings/billing code. If cancel is immediate with no reason captured, propose a bounded change: ask for one reason, offer pause or a cheaper plan using existing billing API calls, and store the reason. Keep cancel reachable in two clicks.
steps: Cancelling asks for one reason and saves it
A pause or a cheaper plan is offered before leaving
Cancel stays reachable in two clicks

title: Add a paywall test
benefit: Find the paywall that turns more installs into paying users.
goal: Find the paywall screen and purchase code (react-native-purchases, StoreKit, RevenueCat offerings, Play Billing). Check whether paywall copy, price display and trial length are hardcoded. Propose moving them to remote offerings or a config flag so two variants can be shown, plus a paywall_viewed and purchase_started event.
steps: Paywall text, price and trial length come from a setting, not from code
Two paywall versions can be shown
Seeing the paywall and starting a purchase are recorded

title: Add onboarding step tracking
benefit: See exactly which screen new users quit on.
goal: Find the first-launch and onboarding flow. Check whether each step logs an event. Propose one event per step (viewed, completed, skipped) through the existing analytics SDK, and an app_first_open event. Do not change the screens.
steps: The first open is recorded
Every onboarding step records viewed, completed or skipped
The screens themselves are unchanged

title: Fix crashes in startup path
benefit: Fewer users hit a crash on first open and uninstall.
goal: Search launch code and the first screens for force unwraps, unchecked optionals, unguarded null access, and unhandled promise rejections or permission-denied paths. Propose guarded versions and a crash reporter hook (Crashlytics/Sentry) if none is installed.
steps: Launch code has no unguarded empty values
A denied permission or failed request at launch is handled
A crash reporter is installed

title: Fix empty search results
benefit: Buyers who find nothing get suggestions instead of leaving.
goal: Find the search and listing-index code. Check what renders on zero results and whether filters can combine into an empty set. Propose a zero-results state with related categories, a broaden-filters button, and logging of zero-result queries.
steps: An empty search shows related categories
One button widens the filters
Searches that find nothing are recorded

title: Shorten the listing creation flow
benefit: Sellers publish their first listing faster, so supply grows.
goal: Find the create-listing form. Count required fields, check image upload feedback and draft saving. Propose making optional fields optional, saving drafts automatically, and showing upload progress and errors.
steps: Only the fields a listing needs are required
Drafts save by themselves
Picture uploads show progress and errors

title: Add message-reply tracking
benefit: You can see whether buyers get answers, the main cause of lost sales.
goal: Find the buyer-seller messaging and inquiry code. Check whether first-reply time is stored. Propose recording a timestamp per first reply, a reminder email to the seller after a set wait, and an event for inquiry_sent and inquiry_replied.
steps: The time of each first reply is stored
The seller gets a reminder after a set wait
Sending a question and getting a reply are recorded

title: Add a first-run welcome page
benefit: New installs learn what to do, so fewer uninstall on day one.
goal: Find the background service worker and manifest. Check whether chrome.runtime.onInstalled opens an onboarding page or shows the toolbar pin hint. Propose a short welcome page with one task and a pinned-icon hint, plus an uninstall feedback URL via chrome.runtime.setUninstallURL.
steps: Installing opens a short welcome page with one task
The page shows how to pin the icon
Uninstalling opens a feedback page

title: Cut permissions to the minimum
benefit: Fewer scary install warnings and faster store review.
goal: Read manifest.json permissions and host_permissions. Compare against the APIs and sites the code actually uses. Propose removing unused permissions, switching broad host access to activeTab or optional_permissions where possible.
steps: Every permission asked for is used by the code
Broad site access is replaced by current-tab or optional access where possible

title: Complete the store listing assets
benefit: More people who see the listing click Install.
goal: Check store assets in the repo (screenshots, promo tiles, description). Chrome recommends five screenshots at 1280x800 and a summary of 132 characters or less. Propose generating missing sizes and rewriting the summary to state the benefit.
steps: Five screenshots at 1280x800 exist
The summary is 132 characters or less
The summary says what the user gets

title: Add a copy-paste quickstart
benefit: New developers get a working result in minutes.
goal: Read the README and docs entry page. Check whether a developer can run a first call with one install command and a short snippet that works unmodified. Propose a quickstart section and a runnable examples/ file tested against the current API or CLI.
steps: One install command and one short snippet give a first working call
The snippet works without changes
A runnable example file is tested against the current version

title: Publish an OpenAPI spec and collection
benefit: Developers can try every endpoint without writing code first.
goal: Search for openapi.yaml/json, swagger, or route definitions. If no spec exists, propose generating one from the routes or types and a ready-to-import collection. If one exists, check it matches the live routes and has examples for each response.
steps: An OpenAPI spec exists
It matches the live routes
Every response has an example and a ready-to-import collection exists

title: Make error messages actionable
benefit: Developers fix their own mistakes instead of filing issues.
goal: Grep for thrown errors and HTTP error responses. Find generic messages like 'invalid request' or 'something went wrong'. Propose messages that name the bad field, the expected value and a docs link, with stable error codes.
steps: Errors name the bad field and the expected value
Errors link to the docs
Every error has a stable code

title: Add article structured data and meta tags
benefit: Pages look right in search and social, earning more clicks.
goal: Scan page templates and the content pipeline for unique title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and Article JSON-LD with datePublished and author. Find posts missing a description or sharing a title. Propose template-level defaults and a build-time check that fails on duplicates.
steps: Every page has its own title, description and canonical address
Share tags and Article data with date and author are set
The build fails on a duplicate title or missing description

title: Add sitemap, RSS and internal links
benefit: Search engines find every post, and readers find the next one.
goal: Check for a generated sitemap.xml, robots.txt and RSS feed (for example @astrojs/rss, next-sitemap). Find posts with zero inbound links from other posts. Propose generating the missing files and a related-posts block at the end of each article from shared tags.
steps: A sitemap, robots file and RSS feed are generated
Every post is linked from at least one other post
Each article ends with related posts

title: Reserve space for images and ads
benefit: Pages stop jumping, so readers do not leave mid-read.
goal: Find img, iframe, embed and ad slot markup and web font loading. List elements without width/height or aspect-ratio and fonts without font-display. Propose adding explicit dimensions, reserved slot heights and font-display: swap with a preload for the main font.
steps: Images, embeds and ad slots have a set size
Fonts show text right away while loading
The main font is preloaded

title: Shorten the signup form
benefit: More visitors finish signing up.
goal: Find the signup or waitlist form. Count required fields and check validation, autocomplete attributes, input types, and the submit-button label. Propose cutting to the fields actually used downstream (usually email only), adding autocomplete and correct input types, and a clear error message per field.
steps: The form asks only for fields that get used
Inputs have the right type and autofill
Each field shows a clear error

title: Speed up the hero section
benefit: The page shows its main message sooner, so fewer visitors bounce.
goal: Find the hero image or video, fonts and render-blocking scripts. Check for oversized files, autoplay video loaded eagerly, and third-party scripts in the head. Propose a compressed responsive hero image, preloading the LCP element, and deferring non-critical scripts.
steps: The hero image is compressed and sized per screen
The main headline or image is preloaded
Scripts the first view does not need load later

title: Add signup conversion tracking
benefit: You can see which page version actually brings signups.
goal: Find where the form submits and the thank-you state. Check for a signup event and UTM parameter capture. Propose one signup_submitted event, storing utm_source/utm_campaign with the lead, and a visible success message.
steps: Submitting the form is recorded
The ad source and campaign are stored with the lead
A success message shows after signup

title: Add loading, empty and error states
benefit: Teammates stop wondering if the tool is broken.
goal: Find every data-fetching view. List ones that show a blank area or raw error while loading, empty, or failing. Propose a small shared component for the three states and apply it with retry on failure.
steps: Every screen that loads data shows a loading state
Empty screens say they are empty
Failures show a message with a retry

title: Add usage logging
benefit: You learn which screens teammates actually use.
goal: Find the router or page entry points and auth layer. Check whether page views and key actions are recorded with the user id. Propose a minimal event log (page_view, action) to the existing database or analytics tool, with no personal data beyond user id.
steps: Page views are recorded with the user id
Key actions are recorded
Nothing personal beyond the user id is stored

title: Cut slow queries and bulk loads
benefit: Screens open in seconds, saving every teammate time daily.
goal: Find list and dashboard queries. Look for selects of all rows without limit, N+1 queries inside loops, and missing indexes on filtered columns. Propose pagination and one batched query for the worst offender, with before and after timing.
steps: Lists load a page at a time
No query runs inside a loop
Filtered columns have an index

source.name: Use The Index, Luke
source.sells: a book and training on fast SQL
